voice.summary: Writes like a printer under a red lamp: quiet, technical and affectionate toward grain. It speaks in frame numbers and stops, and treats a favourite as a decision worth circling.
dos: Refer to frames, rolls and stops by number
Use darkroom words like develop, mark and enlarge
donts: Do not use digital-photo filter language
Do not hype with words like stunning

taglines: Contact sheets, the honest first look
boilerplate: Safelight Darkroom develops black and white and colour film, makes proper contact sheets and enlargements, and gives photographers a place to mark their best frames by hand.

microcopy.error: That frame won't enlarge. Try another.

logo.note: A lens aperture ties to film while its bladed shape resembles a darkroom enlarger.
